decisive_items: Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell
Several round atrophic lesions on his face, symmetric and bilateral
The skin lesions were not indurated and displayed no epidermal changes
response.rationale: The clinical and histologic features—symmetric, non-indurated atrophic lesions with epidermal dell, dermal fibrosis, and reduced elastic fibers—are classic for atrophoderma of Pasini and Pierini. R1 is a similar but less specific variant, while other candidates involve inflammation or different histology.

rejected.why: Discoid lupus requires induration and epidermal changes, which are absent
Follicular atrophoderma is less specific and does not match the symmetric distribution
Dermatomyositis is systemic, not localized atrophic lesions
Lupus erythematosus is inflammatory and not consistent with atrophic non-indurated lesions
Follicular mucinosis does not explain elastic fiber loss or dermal fibrosis
Sarcoidosis involves granulomas, not elastic fiber reduction
Lichen sclerosis is not characterized by atrophic lesions or elastic loss
Erythema elevatum diutinum is elevated, not atrophic
